title: Harry on saxophone and Eddie Miller
summary: Harry prefers clarinet to saxophone, plays tenor, and greatly admires Eddie Miller.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: What do you think about the saxophone that puts you on the spot? I mean, you say you've played sax a little. Do you like it as well as clarinet? No, no, I don't.
I like the clarinet. I like to listen to saxophone. Personally, I like the clarinet. I've heard some very fine saxophone players, but I don't like to play it too much.
But should you play alto or tenor?
I play tenor mostly. Tenor. I like the clarinet. Well, you can tell that from the way you play. You must stay with it a few years. I like to listen to saxophone, but I don't like to play it.
I've heard some very fine saxophone players, like Eddie Miller.
To me, he's the great one. He plays awful fine. That's great. I've heard some very fine saxophone players, like Eddie Miller. Yeah. To me, he's the great one. He plays awful fine.
He plays beautifully. I like it.
I'm telling you, right? I go out of my way just to listen to him. Yeah. That's the Bouchon, isn't it? Yeah, he plays. He certainly is.
